cardEffects:
When one of your Digimon with a Tamer card in its digivolution cards would digivolve into this card in your hand, reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 2.
[When Attacking] If a card with the [Hybrid] or [Insectoid] trait is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon can digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Insectoid] or [Ten Warriors] trait in your hand for a memory cost of 3.
name: RhinoKabuterimon

rulings.answer: No. The effect reads, “This Digimon can digivolve,” so you can choose not to.
rulings.question: I have a card with [Hybrid] or [Insectoid] in its traits in this Digimon's digivolution cards. Does this card’s [When Attacking] effect force me to digivolve this Digimon into a Digimon card with [Insectoid] or [Ten Warriors] in its traits in my hand?

rulings.answer: The attack continues. The turn doesn’t switch over just yet. If the memory gauge is still at 1 or more on your opponent’s side after the attack ends and any effects triggered by it finish activating, only then does the turn switch over.
rulings.question: When digivolving with this card's [When Attacking] effect, paying the digivolution cost moves the memory gauge to 1 or more on my opponent’s side. What happens to the attack?

rulings.answer: No, it is too late to trigger this card's [When Attacking] effect, since the Digimon didn't have it when the attack was declared.
rulings.question: I attack with [EX1-035 Kabuterimon] and digivolve into this card with its [When Attacking] effect. Can I then digivolve again on the same attack with this card's [When Attacking] effect?

rulings.answer: No, you can’t ignore its digivolution requirements.
rulings.question: When digivolving into a Digimon card in my hand with [Insectoid] or [Ten Warriors] in its traits with this card's [When Attacking] effect, can I ignore that card's digivolution requirements?
